_source: Masonry line, CAT-19 Bricks & Blocks and CAT-20 Lintels, DPC & Wall Accessories (MASONRY_CATALOGUE.md). A unit is live only where at least two SA retailers show a regular price for the same product; list = lowest x 1.08. Everything else is quoted with the supplier. Bricks are sold per 1,000; units_per_m2 is the count per m² of single-leaf wall with 10 mm joints.

products.name: Clay Stock Brick (NFP) 222 × 106 × 73 mm
products.grading_standard: SANS 227 burnt clay masonry units — NFP (non-facing plaster)
products.description: Burnt clay stock brick for walls that will be plastered — the everyday South African building brick. Imperial size, about 52 to the square metre of half-brick wall.
typical_uses: Plastered walls — foundations, superstructure and boundary walls
Half-brick (110 mm) and one-brick (220 mm) walls
products.handling_notes: Stack on a level, firm base close to where they'll be laid; keep cement bricks and blocks off wet ground and cover them in rain. Check the delivery against the order before the truck leaves.

units.source_note: Cashbuild 'Brick Clay Stock' R2.37 each (lowest; a R0.15 handling fee is excluded); Buco NFP clay stock brick from R2.68 each. Per-brick benchmark x 1,000. checked 2026-10-10 via retailer search listings (pages undated; product pages could not be opened from the build environment — confirm before relying on them). Benchmark = lowest regular (non-promo) VAT-inclusive price; list = benchmark x 1.08 (8% AA storefront markup).

products.name: Clay Face Brick (FBS) 222 × 106 × 73 mm
products.description: Burnt clay face brick for walls left unplastered. Colour, texture and price depend on the range and the brickyard — tell us the range you want, or ask for samples.
products.handling_notes: Stack on a level, firm base close to where they'll be laid; keep cement bricks and blocks off wet ground and cover them in rain. Check the delivery against the order before the truck leaves. Order a whole wall's face bricks from one batch so the colour matches.

units.source_note: Face brick prices depend on the range and brickyard — quoted with the supplier.

products.name: Clay Face Brick (FBX) 222 × 106 × 73 mm
products.grading_standard: SANS 227 — FBX (face brick extra, tighter tolerances)

products.handling_notes: Stack on a level, firm base close to where they'll be laid; keep cement bricks and blocks off wet ground and cover them in rain. Check the delivery against the order before the truck leaves.

units.source_note: Face brick prices depend on the range and brickyard — quoted with the supplier.

products.name: Prestressed Concrete Lintel 1.2 m
products.grading_standard: Prestressed concrete lintel — section to the maker's table
products.description: Precast prestressed concrete lintel, 1.2 m long, built into the brickwork over a door or window opening — one per brick leaf, with the bearing at each end and the opening span the maker's span table allows.
products.handling_notes: Carry and stack the right way up (the marked top face up), on bearers. Never cut a prestressed lintel.

units.source_note: Retail lintel sections and prices differ too much to compare like for like — quoted with the supplier.

products.name: Damp-Proof Course 375 µm, 110 mm × 40 m
products.description: Black polyolefin damp-proof course, 110 mm wide, laid in the mortar bed at floor level and under sills to stop rising damp. Suits a half-brick (110 mm) wall.
typical_uses: Under window sills and over cavity trays
products.handling_notes: Lap joints at least 150 mm and keep the DPC continuous through the wall; don't puncture it.
